description: This file defines the DdlWriter class responsible for serializing DocumentObject and DocumentObjectCollection instances into DDL format, either to strings or files, with configurable indentation.

classes.name: DdlWriter
classes.description: A class for writing DocumentObject instances to DDL format, supporting multiple output methods and configurations.

methods.name: DdlWriter
methods.description: Constructors for initializing DdlWriter with Stream, filename, or TextWriter.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the serializer and underlying writer.

methods.name: WriteDocument
methods.description: Serializes a DocumentObject or DocumentObjectCollection to DDL.

methods.name: WriteToString
methods.description: Converts DocumentObject or DocumentObjectCollection to DDL string with specified indentation.

methods.name: WriteToFile
methods.description: Writes DocumentObject or DocumentObjectCollection to a DDL file with specified indentation.
